custom: Textured low-top Derby; lace-up front; contrast sole edge
highlights:
Textured plain-toe profile: A grained surface and uncluttered vamp give this lace-up shoe a clear business-casual direction.

Open-lacing construction: Separate eyelet panels sit over the vamp, with four visible lace rows for adjustment across the instep.

Contrast sole edge: A light border separates the upper from the darker low-heel sole, while the heel and side seams define the back profile.

Two neutral options: Black and Grey, with EU38-44 sizes for coordinated office and everyday footwear assortments.

Wholesale planning: Send colour-size quantities, packing preference and destination for an order quotation.
